checks.cases: correct passed, injected fault failed as expected, repair passed

limitations: Development verification only; official evaluation has not run.
No synthesis or board verification performed.
Behavior before synchronous reset is not specified by the problem and is not asserted by the testbench.
implementation: TopModule preserves clk/reset/in/done ports. Active-high synchronous reset enters idle. Eight data samples follow the start sample; a high stop sample produces done for one cycle. A low stop enters recovery until a high sample, without asserting done. The next sample may start a new byte.
width_decisions: Three-bit data counter covers all eight data samples; no received payload storage is required.
static_review: Complete combinational state cases, nonblocking sequential assignments, explicit enum if/else transitions, no added ports or latency.
testbench_coverage: Independent remaining-samples oracle, all 256 payloads, back-to-back frames, invalid stops and prolonged recovery, reset during partial frames and completion, randomized serial/reset samples, pre-edge stability and bounded timeout.
